snippet.title: Ashen Legacy – Official Gameplay Trailer | Dark Fantasy Pixel Art Action RPG
snippet.description:
⚔️ Enter a World Buried in Ashes.

Ashen Legacy is a dark fantasy pixel-art Action RPG where danger lurks around every corner.

🔥 Fight. Explore. Survive.

🗡️ Battle dangerous monsters and powerful bosses.
🌑 Explore mysterious lands filled with secrets.
⚔️ Master your combat skills, dodge deadly attacks, and upgrade your character.
💎 Discover powerful equipment and grow stronger as you face the darkness.

Every battle is a challenge. Every step brings you closer to uncovering the secrets hidden within the ashes.

🎮 THE DEMO IS NOW LIVE ON STEAM!

👉 Play the Demo & Wishlist Ashen Legacy:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5164260/Ashen_Legacy/

💬 I'm an indie game developer from Vietnam, and I've spent nearly 2 years bringing Ashen Legacy to life. Your feedback and support mean a lot to me!

If you enjoy the game, please consider playing the demo, leaving feedback, and adding Ashen Legacy to your Steam wishlist. Every wishlist helps this indie project grow!

Thank you for supporting Ashen Legacy! ❤️

#AshenLegacy #IndieGame #PixelArt #ActionRPG #GameplayTrailer
